newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Striking Portugal copper miners to step up action.
newsitem.headline: Striking Portugal copper miners to step up action.

text.p: Hundreds of striking copper workers, who have brought output to a halt at the Neves Corvo mine in southern Portugal, threatened on Thursday to step up their action with protests outside company headquarters in Lisbon.
As the strike went into its fourth day, leaders told journalists they were giving management until 0930 GMT to agree to demands for an immediate return to a six-day shift.
The strike at the 107,000-tonne per year mine began on Monday after the managing company, state-controlled Somincor, imposed Sunday working as part of an efficiency drive.
Miners say that they are prepared to negotiate a return to work but management must first reinstate the six-day week.
The company says that it can maintain normal deliveries of copper for a week but would then have to warn customers that they could face reductions in supply.
